models.name: todo_app_users
models.description: Main user table with email/password authentication credentials. Each user can have one profile, multiple todos, multiple sessions, password reset tokens, and email verification tokens. This is the core actor entity for the authentication system.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for user identification and authentication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password using bcrypt algorithm.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was soft-deleted. Null if active. Supports trash management workflow for account deletion with recovery possibility.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens with access and refresh token support. Each session represents a logged-in state for a user with connection metadata and expiration tracking.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address when session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Page URL (href) when session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL when session was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. Sessions beyond this time are invalid.

models.description: Password reset tokens with expiration for password recovery
models.name: todo_app_user_password_resets

plainFields.description: Password reset token for verification.
plainFields.name: token

plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Reset requests older than this are invalid.
plainFields.name: expired_at

models.description: Email verification tokens for account verification workflows

foreignFields.description: User who needs email verification {@link todo_app_users.id}
foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id

models.name: todo_app_user_email_verifications

plainFields.description: Creation timestamp
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Update timestamp
plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.description: Deletion timestamp for soft delete
plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.description: Main todo items belonging to users with title, optional description and dates. Each todo is owned by exactly one user and cannot be accessed by other users. Supports soft delete functionality through is_deleted flag. Deleted todos appear in the user's trash until permanently deleted or restored. The table maintains a one-to-many relationship with todo_app_todo_histories for edit history tracking.
models.name: todo_app_todos

plainFields.description: Todo title. Required field. Minimum 1 character, maximum 255 characters. Trimmed of leading and trailing whitespace before storage.
plainFields.name: title

plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the todo item.
plainFields.name: description

plainFields.description: Optional start date for the todo item. NULL indicates no start date set. Used for sorting - todos without start_date appear at the end when sorted by start_date.
plainFields.name: start_date

plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo item. NULL indicates no due date set. Used for sorting - todos without due_date appear at the end when sorted by due_date.
plainFields.name: due_date

plainFields.description: Completion status flag. false indicates incomplete (default), true indicates completed.
plainFields.name: is_complete

plainFields.description: Soft delete flag. false indicates active todo (appears in normal list), true indicates deleted/todo is in trash. Deleted todos do not appear in normal todo list views.
plainFields.name: is_deleted

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was created.
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was last updated.
plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was soft-deleted (is_deleted set to true). NULL indicates the todo is not deleted.
plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: todo_app_todo_histories
models.description: History of edits made to todo items tracking all changes over time. Each edit creates a new history entry recording the previous and new values for all changed fields. Belongs to exactly one todo with cascade deletion when todo is permanently removed.

foreignFields.name: todo_id
foreignFields.description: The todo item this history entry belongs to. {@link todo_app_todos.id}

plainFields.name: edited_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this edit was made.

plainFields.name: previous_title
plainFields.description: Previous title value before this edit (null if title unchanged).

plainFields.name: new_title
plainFields.description: New title value after this edit (null if title unchanged).

plainFields.name: previous_description
plainFields.description: Previous description value before this edit (null if description unchanged).

plainFields.name: new_description
plainFields.description: New description value after this edit (null if description unchanged).

plainFields.name: previous_start_date
plainFields.description: Previous start_date value before this edit (null if start_date unchanged).

plainFields.name: new_start_date
plainFields.description: New start_date value after this edit (null if start_date unchanged).

plainFields.name: previous_due_date
plainFields.description: Previous due_date value before this edit (null if due_date unchanged).

plainFields.name: new_due_date
plainFields.description: New due_date value after this edit (null if due_date unchanged).

models.name: todo_app_todo_sorting_indexes
models.description:
Indexes for efficient sorting by start_date and due_date with NULL handling.

This table stores computed index values that enable efficient date-based sorting
while handling todos without dates appropriately. Used for performance optimization
when displaying sorted todo lists.

plainFields.name: start_date_sort_value
plainFields.description: Computed sort value for start_date (0 for NULL, Unix timestamp for valid dates).

plainFields.name: due_date_sort_value
plainFields.description: Computed sort value for due_date (0 for NULL, Unix timestamp for valid dates).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.
